import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
/**
 * 主线扫荡指令
 * 指令格式：/主线扫荡 1-1  或  /主线扫荡 1-1 5
 * 次数参数可选，默认 1 次，支持 9999 以内的正整数
 * 三星关卡可扫荡，跳过战斗直接发奖
 */
import { MSG_STORYLINE } from '@src/constants/messages';
import App from '@src/response-apps/storyline/sweep/app';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { addOptions, FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
import { withBackendRepeatDetection } from '@src/utils/backendRepeatDetector';
import { Format, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

type ParsedCommand = { ok: true; chapterNumber: number; stageNumber: number; times: number } | { ok: false; isCommand: boolean; message: string };
const MAX_SWEEP_TIMES = 9999;

function parseCommand(text: string): ParsedCommand {
  const raw = (text ?? '').trim();
  const cleaned = raw.replace(/^(!|！|\/|#|＃)?\s*/, '');

  if (!cleaned.startsWith('主线扫荡')) {
    return { ok: false, isCommand: false, message: '' };
  }

  // 支持 "主线扫荡 1-1" 和 "主线扫荡 1-1 5"
  const match = cleaned.match(/^主线扫荡\s+(\d+)\s*[-－]\s*(\d+)(?:\s+(\d+))?$/);

  if (!match) {
    return { ok: false, isCommand: true, message: '格式错误，正确用法：/主线扫荡 章-关 [次数]（如 /主线扫荡 1-1 5）' };
  }

  const chapterNumber = Number(match[1]);
  const stageNumber = Number(match[2]);
  const times = match[3] ? Number(match[3]) : 1;

  if (chapterNumber < 1) {
    return { ok: false, isCommand: true, message: '章节编号须为正整数' };
  }
  if (stageNumber < 1 || stageNumber > 4) {
    return { ok: false, isCommand: true, message: '关卡范围 1-4' };
  }
  if (times < 1) {
    return { ok: false, isCommand: true, message: MSG_STORYLINE.SWEEP_TIMES_POSITIVE };
  }
  if (times > MAX_SWEEP_TIMES) {
    return { ok: false, isCommand: true, message: MSG_STORYLINE.SWEEP_TIMES_TOO_LARGE };
  }

  return { ok: true, chapterNumber, stageNumber, times };
}

export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;

  const parsed = parseCommand(e.MessageText || '');

  if (!parsed.ok) {
    if (parsed.isCommand && parsed.message) {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      md.addText(parsed.message);

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '主线扫荡', content: md }));
    }

    return;
  }

  const uid = e.uid as number;
  const { chapterNumber, stageNumber, times } = parsed;

  const request = createBackendRequestContext(e);
  const result = await App({ messageText: e.MessageText, bid, uid, chapterNumber, stageNumber, times, request });

  if (result.code !== 'OK') {
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    const messageText = result.data.message;
    const failMsg = await withBackendRepeatDetection(bid, uid, e.MessageText, messageText, request);

    md.addText(failMsg);
    const footer = messageText.includes('精力不足') ? [{ label: '服用精力丹', command: '/服用 精力丹 3' }] : undefined;

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '主线扫荡', content: md, footer }));

    return;
  }

  // 构建结算展示
  const contentMd = Format.createMarkdown();

  contentMd.addText(`扫荡完成：${result.data.stageLabel} × ${result.data.times}次`);
  contentMd.addNewline();
  contentMd.addNewline();

  contentMd.addText(`消耗精力：${result.data.totalSpiritCost}`);
  contentMd.addNewline();

  contentMd.addText(`获得修为：+${result.data.totalExp}${result.data.expBonusText}`);
  contentMd.addNewline();
  contentMd.addText(`获得灵石：+${result.data.totalSpiritStone}`);
  contentMd.addNewline();

  if (result.data.allItemsGained.length > 0) {
    contentMd.addNewline();
    contentMd.addText('额外掉落：');
    contentMd.addNewline();

    for (const item of result.data.allItemsGained) {
      contentMd.addBlockquote(
        addOptions(Format.createMarkdown().addText(`${item.name} × ${item.amount} `), [{ label: '详情', command: `/物品详情 道具 ${item.itemId}` }])
      );
    }
  }

  void message.send(
    FormatGui({
      isPrivate,
      bid,
      title: '主线扫荡',
      header: [
        { label: '返回', command: `/查看主线 ${chapterNumber}` },
        { label: '主线', command: '/查看主线' },
        { label: '秘境', command: '/查看秘境' }
      ],
      content: contentMd,
      footer: [{ label: `继续扫荡×${times}`, command: `/主线扫荡 ${chapterNumber}-${stageNumber} ${times}` }]
    })
  );
});
